data.rationale: The proposal gets the core steps right in order (Special Events list, event, ticket count, time/Book Now, Reserve Now), but it leaves out selecting the city and the city parameter, uses event_name instead of date to pick the event, and adds a vague 'NEXT' confirm step, so an automation could not reliably pick the right city or event.
